notes.title: Minor Bug Fix
notes.content: The game should be fully possible now! There was a minor bug leading to a door killing the player even when it was open. I was aware of the bug pre-release and fixed it, but the fix somehow didn't make it into the full release. Hope this didn't sully your opinion of the game too much, have fun!

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content: [p]Very sorry, I know it must be disappointing considering how soon this is after release.[/p][p][/p][p]I have noticed a bug regarding the 6th level in the white void, the level may be impossible. I have located the issue and made a fix, however I can not publish this change until this Saturday. I hope you will forgive my delay, and enjoy the rest of the game in the meantime.[/p]
